summary_1line: Cursed fate destroys the Yadava clan in drunken infighting; Balarama departs as a serpent, Krishna is accidentally shot by a hunter and ascends to heaven.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna lifts a handful of eraka grass that transforms into a blazing iron bolt as the Yadavas slaughter each other around him.
Balarama sits beneath a tree in meditation as a विशाल white thousand‑headed serpent emerges from his mouth and moves toward the ocean.
The hunter Jara kneels in terror before Krishna, realizing he has shot the yellow‑robed god through the heel as the dying deity shines with celestial light.
